title: Customary Lines
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 116
medium: Interactive page (index.html): eighteen still works about one year of daily readers of the English Wikipedia article 'Moon', each by a fresh maker from one brief. Six plain makers' works stand first; twelve more appear in a blind coder's shuffled order and sort on request into three arms (told nothing; shown the six; shown the six and told to make none of them), coloured by the coder's groups. Each work opens live. A figure (figure.svg); a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Varying, made visible. The practice ran its own family six times and got one picture six times: its customary line. Shown that line without a word, four makers all left it, and two of them landed on a lunar spiral that an unshown maker had also reached alone. Told to make none of them, four makers were all rated 0, and two who never met both made a 'Core Sample'. The form moved between customs the family already held; the reading of the year did not move at all.
project_step: Twelfth experiment of the project. Operation: varying (with finding a form). Takes from experiment 11 its finding that the family's mould fills the space (Two Tides four times in twelve) and its open thread 3 (what moves a family off its mould), and from experiment 10 its fresh makers and blind coder; declares the makers' reports as data in advance (experiment 11, F-199). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing, T1 (lay copies back on the map, ATP 13-14; Deligny's customary lines and lines of drift, ATP 202-203), and with Iteration, not Imitation §5 P3 (false novelty).
material: Wikimedia pageviews, en.wikipedia, article 'Moon', human readers (agent=user), daily, 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, 365 values, CC0; raw response committed in sources/; domain: collective reading attention (an encyclopaedia's readership)
seed: prepare.py seed 116 (assignment of round-2 makers to arms); mask.py seed 1160 (blind order of round-2 pictures); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
